name: ir_get_presentations
description:
Investor and earnings presentations (slide decks) of a supported company, from its investor relations site.
Returns {ticker, count, presentations: [{title, url, type, year, quarter, date, description, ticker, is_pdf, context}], success}: investor presentations first, then earnings presentations, duplicates (same URL) removed.
Inputs (* required): ticker* (string, stock symbol such as AAPL or MSFT; case-insensitive), limit (integer 1-30, default 10).
Only tickers in SAJHA's built-in company list work (ir_list_supported_companies); others fail with 'not supported'. The SEC fallback returns filings, not slide decks. For the latest quarter only use ir_get_latest_earnings.
Example: {"ticker": "JPM", "limit": 5}

limit.description: Maximum number of presentations to return
